items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance st off should
 carry the suitable
safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

The Disconnect switch must be isolated completely 
 and grounded on both sides .

Isolate the DC voltage. (Switch off the control 
 circuit and Insert closing and tripping preventive pins.)

Suitable tool set (screwdrivers, keys..etc. ) 
 .
Voltage indicator.

Cleaning materials ( Pieces of soft clothes 
 and rags ).

Soft sand paper and cleaning liquid ( like 
 gasoline ).
Carbon grease and silicon grease.
Air blower.
Check for signs of overheating at terminals and retighten if necessary.

Check the motion transmission shaft for three 
 phase and retighten all coupling bolts and joints.

Check the motion transmission shaft of motor 
 and retighten the bolts if required.

Check the operation stroke through the 
 disconnect switch operation ( ON and OFF ) through remote and local ( hand and 
 motor ) and observe any unusual sound .

Clean mechanism box ( use blower and clothes ) 
 .

Check the earthing connection of mechanism box 
 and retighten if necessary.

Check to ensure there are no locks or pins 
 missed from the motion transmission joints.
Check the gasket of mechanism box door.

Gear box mechanism of motion transmission must 
 be lubricated with silicon grease.

Check the bearings of the four driver levers 
 and replace it if necessary.

Check the silver layer at main contacts and 
 that it have no erosion or rust.

The disconnect switch functions should be 
 checked after every short-circuit has occurred.
